sentences.text: The Auditor General has not published a stand-alone report on the WE Charity contribution agreement; references to the agreement appear in committee proceedings and proactive disclosure rather than in performance audits.
The dataset records a single agreement of $543,053,427 between Employment and Social Development Canada and WE Charity Foundation, dated June 23, 2020.
The agreement was terminated on July 3, 2020, and the records show two subsequent amendments reducing the value to zero.
The Departmental Results Report for ESDC for fiscal year 2020–21 references the Canada Student Service Grant program but does not disclose performance outcomes against the program.
The House of Commons Standing Committee on Finance held hearings on the agreement during July and August 2020.
Documents tabled before that committee include the original WE Charity proposal and the contribution agreement itself.
The CRA charity registry records WE Charity Foundation as a registered public foundation, BN 118810988RR0001, charity status active.
The most recent T3010 filing for the foundation reports total revenue of $65.8M for fiscal year 2020.

unverifiable.rationale: The Canada Student Service Grant did not proceed to delivery; outcomes against the program design cannot be assessed from the public record.

pullQuote.text: The dataset records a single agreement reduced to zero by two subsequent amendments.
